headline: Executive order sets updated pay rates for certain federal workers, likely for the year 2010.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order adjusts pay rates for certain federal government jobs. Presidents usually sign an order like this near the end of each year to set new pay tables for the coming year. The exact groups covered and the size of any changes are not stated in the material provided.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may change under the updated schedules this order sets.
